verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows only Evidence Library API endpoints (create, update, delete, and versioning of evidence items). That is a storage primitive, not the manual-evidence workflow the story asks for. Nothing documents owners assigned to manual artifacts, due dates, renewal reminders, or expiry tracking.

support.subject: As an operations lead, evidence that can't be automated has a real workflow — owners, due dates, renewal reminders, and expiry tracking on every manual artifact
